node.title: case-insensitive hash keys
node.author: ManFromNeptune
node.doctext:
Is there a way (module?) to create/access hash arrays where the keys are case-insensitive? So,

my %assoc = (); $assoc{'TheKey'} = "test"; print $assoc{'theKEY'} . "\n"; ...would return "test".

thanks for any suggestions...
MFN
